summary.zh-Hans: 圣地亚哥的森林公园沿马波乔河南侧延伸，有草地和林荫步行空间。
summary.en: Santiago’s Parque Forestal runs along the south side of the Mapocho River, with lawns and tree-lined walking spaces.

names.zh-Hans: 圣地亚哥缆车 Oasis 站

summary.zh-Hans: Oasis 是圣地亚哥缆车 Pedro de Valdivia 线的起点站，位于都会公园相应入口附近，周边设有休息空间。
summary.en: Oasis is the starting station of Teleférico Santiago’s Pedro de Valdivia line, near that entrance to Parque Metropolitano, with spaces to rest nearby.

summary.zh-Hans: 智利的皮诺馅饺以面皮包住肉、洋葱等馅料，有烤制的做法。馅料也可加入蛋和葡萄干。
summary.en: Chilean empanadas de pino enclose a meat-and-onion filling in pastry and may be baked. Egg and raisins can also be included.

summary.zh-Hans: 智利玉米派在肉与洋葱等馅料上盖一层玉米糊后烘烤；配方中也可有鸡肉和熟蛋。
summary.en: Chilean pastel de choclo is baked with a layer of ground corn over a meat-and-onion filling; versions can include chicken and hard-boiled egg.
